title: Construction of double S-scheme CeO2/BHN/I−-BiOIO3 heterojunctions for enhanced photocatalytic degradation of norfloxacin
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,1112-1126
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00902B, Paper
Fengyang Jing, Shimeng Chang, Xingyu Zhang, Chenliang Zhou, Yao Weng, Xuewei Li, Hongmei Ye, Yuting Sun, Jiuyang Lin, Wenyuan Ye, Wenjing Yuan
The synergistic effect of double S-scheme heterojunctions and I− modification endows CeO2/BHN/I−-BiOIO3 with excellent ability for the photocatalytic degradation of norfloxacin.
